purpose: Tune existing KeyCorridor AWAC continuations within A_update=alpha*A_ref+beta*Delta_A, alpha,beta>=0.
primary_metric: normalized trapezoidal mean success over recorded checkpoints 0..128
final_metric: success after 512 actor updates; not used to select hyperparameters
actor_signal: alpha*Q_old+beta*D, centered under detached current pi; algebraically alpha*A_ref+beta*Delta_A

screening.selection: fixed SHA256 order of seed IDs, independent of outcomes

expansion.rule: Top 4 screen configurations, the historical incumbent, (1,1), and the highest-scoring positive diagonal setting; evaluate each on all 20 original seeds to 128 updates.
expansion.ties: smaller alpha+beta, then alpha, then beta, then ID

final_selection: Highest mean early success over all 20 seeds among expanded configurations, then tie rules.
continuation: Resume the selected setting for every original seed to 512 updates from complete 128-update checkpoint.
inference: Development tuning and reporting share seed cohorts. No held-out claim. All seeds and all candidate results retained.
boundary_rule: Fixed bounded grid; report any boundary winner rather than claim global optimality.

controls.alpha=beta=1: full revaluation; direct-PE advantage equivalence requires accurate reference and closed support
controls.alpha=beta>0: scaled full revaluation; controls common signal magnitude/temperature
controls.alpha=0,beta>0: change-only variant, now included in the method family
controls.alpha=beta=0: unit AWAC weights / unweighted replay behavior cloning

resource_policy: 8 authorized GPUs, initially 2 workers per GPU; complete checkpoint per candidate, no reduced tensor substitute.
numerical_failure: Retain failures; do not replace seeds or silently select over incomplete candidates.
checkpoint_scope: Full models, target networks, Adam optimizers, CPU/CUDA/NumPy/Python RNG plus immutable input and schedule hashes.
runtime_scope: Concurrent synchronized training blocks, separate scoring/serialization; not an isolated performance benchmark.
